page_title: JUV 0-4 ATA | Juventus v Atalanta 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Simone Sozza is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
90+1' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

89' Marco Carnesecchi makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Weston McKennie (Juventus) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
86' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Weston McKennie (Juventus) inside the box.
86' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
84' That will be all from Sead Kolasinac who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rafael Toloi (Atalanta).
82' Total attempts – 6:18.
80' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) replacing Ademola Lookman.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ederson as he is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).

77' 0 - 4 GOAL 0:4! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.
75' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Randal Kolo Muani and he is replaced by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
73' Ederson (Atalanta) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
71' The game is interrupted now, Ederson (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.

66' 0 - 3 What a goal! Sead Kolasinac plays it to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Michele Di Gregorio into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
66' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
65' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Atalanta have a corner.
62' Handball! A player from Juventus handled the ball.
61' Substitution. Mateo Retegui leaves the pitch and is replaced by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
60' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
59' Simone Sozza couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ederson (Atalanta) and blew his whistle.
57' Some neat passing and movement from Juventus as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
54' Substitution. Federico Gatti walks off the pitch and Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
54' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Timothy Weah walks off the pitch to be replaced by Alberto Costa (Juventus).
53' It's time for a substitution. Samuel Mbangula (Juventus) comes on in place of Nicolas Gonzalez.
50' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
49' Weston McKennie (Juventus) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
46' 0 - 2 Goal! Marten de Roon (Atalanta) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 0:2.
46' Thiago Motta makes a switch. Teun Koopmeiners is coming on in place of Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) is replaced by Marco Brescianini.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Simone Sozza blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) who directs his shot to the bottom right corner, but the keeper is there in time to stop his effort.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
45+1' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the right side of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio keeps it out with an amazing save.
45+1' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fires in a shot from the edge of the box which deflects off one of the defending players and hits the right post!
45+1' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
44' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' What was Isak Hien (Atalanta) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

39' What a poor attempt! Marten de Roon (Atalanta) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
37' Simone Sozza interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
34' Flag up against Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
32' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Michele Di Gregorio.
29' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is going to take the penalty!
28' The players claim that Weston McKennie (Juventus) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. Atalanta are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
26' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Atalanta.
25' Timothy Weah (Juventus) trips an opposition player and Simone Sozza signals a foul.

22' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
21' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
20' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Timothy Weah (Juventus) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
14' The resulting corner, taken by Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta), comes to nothing.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
13' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
10' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
9' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
8' A wild pass somehow finds Khephren Thuram (Juventus) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
5' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
5' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
3' A pass from Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio keeps it out with an amazing save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
